About this review

Original review questions based on Discover Futures 4, Unit 1 (Student’s Book pp. 4–11), the class language work, and Denise Taylor’s The Silent Forest. Technology questions concern listening possibilities; describing trends is excluded. The reading and story are not reproduced here.

Short-response examples are models, not the only acceptable answers. This review samples understanding; it does not test live listening or spoken performance.
